findings.description: The implementation uses `remainder > 5` instead of `remainder >= 5`, which causes it to round down instead of up for exact half-cent ties (where the remainder is 5).
findings.evidence: calling `candidate.cents(5)` returns `0`, but the expected output is `1` according to the specification.

review.summary: The implementation fails to correctly round up on exact half-cent ties (when the remainder is 5).
